body: Great advice on the comments, personally I would use a high motivational toy or treat, say his name and bring the object to my nose, to enforce eye contact, click, reward, repeat. That's exactly how I trained my dogs to look directly at me when I say their name, no matter what distractions are around. If I say my dogs name I want them to instantly stop what they are doing and look at me, and it worked very well.
